name: the-index
description: A band above the prompt that shows the status line: session, model, context, cache, rate limits, per-call and session telemetry, and git diffs. With a subagent transcript open, it shows that agent's model, effort, type and status.

dim.title: Dim level
dim.description: Brightness of every colour, from 0.1 to 1. 1 draws full colour. statusline.py uses 0.95.

cache_ttl.title: Prompt-cache TTL
cache_ttl.description: The cache lifetime the warm-cache countdown counts down from. The mod API does not report it.

glyphs.title: Context glyphs
glyphs.description: unicode draws the context circle in 5 steps with standard characters. nerd draws it in 9 steps with Nerd Font circle slices, which need a Nerd Font in the terminal.

show_remote.title: Show: Remote Control status
show_remote.description: Draw ● before the session name while a Remote Control client is connected, and ○ while the session is linked with none connected.

show_model.title: Show: Model, effort and agent
show_model.description: Draw the model, effort and agent segment.

show_context.title: Show: Context fill and compactions
show_context.description: Draw the context fill and compactions segment.

show_rate_limits.title: Show: 5-hour and 7-day rate limits
show_rate_limits.description: Draw the 5-hour and 7-day rate limits segment.

show_calls.title: Show: Per-call telemetry (Δ line)
show_calls.description: Draw the per-call telemetry (Δ line) segment.

show_totals.title: Show: Session totals (Σ line)
show_totals.description: Draw the session totals (Σ line) segment.

show_commit_diff.title: Show: Branch and working-tree diff
show_commit_diff.description: Draw the branch and working-tree diff segment.

show_pr_diff.title: Show: Ahead/behind and PR diff against the base branch
show_pr_diff.description: Draw the ahead/behind and PR diff against the base branch segment.

show_agent_view.title: Show: Subagent model, effort, type and status while its transcript is open
show_agent_view.description: Draw the subagent model, effort, type and status while its transcript is open segment.

color_primary.title: Colour: Primary
color_primary.description: Hex colour of the band's values, such as #d75f00. A colour set below for one segment overrides it, and an agent's own colour replaces it while that agent runs. The dim level scales it.

color_session.title: Colour: Session name
color_session.description: Hex colour. At #d75f00 it follows Colour: Primary. The dim level scales it.

color_model.title: Colour: Model, effort and agent
color_model.description: Hex colour. At #d75f00 it follows Colour: Primary. The dim level scales it.

color_ide.title: Colour: IDE name
color_ide.description: Hex colour. At #d75f00 it follows Colour: Primary. The dim level scales it.

color_uptime.title: Colour: Uptime
color_uptime.description: Hex colour. At #d75f00 it follows Colour: Primary. The dim level scales it.

color_resets.title: Colour: Rate-limit reset countdowns
color_resets.description: Hex colour. At #d75f00 it follows Colour: Primary. The dim level scales it.

color_calls.title: Colour: Per-call values
color_calls.description: Hex colour. At #d75f00 it follows Colour: Primary. The dim level scales it.

color_totals.title: Colour: Session-total values
color_totals.description: Hex colour. At #d75f00 it follows Colour: Primary. The dim level scales it.

color_project.title: Colour: Project folder
color_project.description: Hex colour. At #d75f00 it follows Colour: Primary. The dim level scales it.

color_branch.title: Colour: Branch and base names
color_branch.description: Hex colour. At #d75f00 it follows Colour: Primary. The dim level scales it.

color_icons.title: Colour: Icons and separators
color_icons.description: Hex colour, such as #808080. The dim level scales it.

color_good.title: Colour: Good level (low use, high cache hit, additions)
color_good.description: Hex colour, such as #008700. The dim level scales it.

color_warn.title: Colour: Warning level
color_warn.description: Hex colour, such as #d7d700. The dim level scales it.

color_high.title: Colour: High level and compaction tally
color_high.description: Hex colour, such as #d75f00. The dim level scales it.

color_bad.title: Colour: Bad level (high use, low cache hit, deletions)
color_bad.description: Hex colour, such as #c80000. The dim level scales it.

color_cold.title: Colour: Cold prompt cache
color_cold.description: Hex colour, such as #00afd7. The dim level scales it.

color_rules.title: Colour: Lines around open rows
color_rules.description: Hex colour of the lines above and below the open rows. Empty draws them in the prompt border's colour, or the agent's colour when the agent defines one.
